reason: Only the OpenAI Responses adapter's output parsing and replay change: a message the route labels phase=commentary is reasoning (and is replayed to the same route as a phase=commentary message ahead of its calls) instead of answer text. #521 (9114b6f) had folded it into answer text, leaving test_responses_commentary_phase_is_reasoning_not_answer_text red on main since 2026-09-22. Selected: all of test_native_adapter_outcomes.py (Responses commentary, unlabelled prose beside a call, final_answer phase, and the refusal/blocked/failed paths whose message parsing was restructured, plus the other native adapters' outcome tests in the same file); all of test_reasoning_replay.py (the Responses replay test whose expected replay changed, and the other providers' prose-beside-call replay contract from #521, which this must not disturb); and the one test_providers.py node that parses a Responses commentary message. Counts from pytest --collect-only: 35 + 22 + 1 = 58.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or route change; commentary now reaches the transcript through the existing reasoning channel (test_reasoning_replay.py's Responses chat run asserts the saved message keeps commentary in reasoning, not content). Other Responses adapter files (test_provider_contracts.py, test_tool_call_assembly.py, test_provider_leftovers.py, test_native_adapter_requests.py, test_prompt_caching.py, test_reasoning_controls.py, test_synthesis_tool_declarations.py) are excluded: none sends a phase field, and non-commentary messages parse exactly as before. test_chat_leftovers.py is excluded: it stubs ModelResponse text directly and never reaches the adapter. No real OpenAI Responses provider or browser journey was exercised. No full suite.
